title: Stock Entry — a stock movement with no trading commitment
description: A stock entry moves stock when no order stands behind the movement: a receipt with no purchase order, an issue to production, a warehouse transfer, a manufacture. purpose is required and closed because it is the field that decides which warehouses the document must name — the conditional requirements below are expressed in the schema itself (if/then), so a transfer that names one warehouse is a schema violation rather than a rule someone has to remember.

purpose.description: Why the stock moved. Closed because it selects the required warehouse set — an open vocabulary here would make the conditional below unenforceable.

from_warehouse.description: The source warehouse. Required for an issue, a transfer and a manufacture; forbidden for a receipt.

to_warehouse.description: The destination warehouse. Required for a receipt, a transfer and a manufacture; forbidden for an issue.

warehouse.description: Per-line override of the document's warehouse.

batch_no.description: The batch, required only for items the item master declares as batch-tracked.

valuation_rate.description: The rate the stock ledger entry is written at.

harvest: the stock entry field surface (purpose, from and to warehouse, batch, valuation rate)
the purpose vocabulary that selects which warehouses a movement must name
stock movement as a document family of its own rather than an implicit effect of trading documents
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream stock entry doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
